edge_cases.trigger: metal movement beyond the stated tolerance while a quote is open or just expired
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the movement clause to recompute only the metal line at the current dated basis, keep time and options unchanged, and re-issue with a new window rather than renegotiating the whole quote

edge_cases.description: A fine chain or pierced filigree piece consumes far more gold than the estimate because solution wetted every interior surface
edge_cases.trigger: interior and hidden surfaces were excluded from the area estimate for a hollow, nested or pierced piece
edge_cases.mitigation: force an explicit interior-surface decision in the area method, quote such pieces from a reference-piece factor rather than a silhouette, and reconcile the actual draw into that factor afterwards

edge_cases.description: A stone-set piece needs stones removed and reset for the process to be safe, and that work costs more than the plating itself
edge_cases.trigger: settings, glue or heat-sensitive stones make the piece unplatable as presented
edge_cases.mitigation: price removal and resetting as named options if the shop or its partner can do them well, otherwise decline on the capability threshold and hand the verdict to intake for referral

edge_cases.description: A single small item is presented whose honest minimum charge exceeds what the piece is worth
edge_cases.trigger: a job below the size at which fixed setup steps can be recovered proportionally
edge_cases.mitigation: explain the minimum as setup rather than as metal, offer the batched small-item route with its longer window, and let the customer choose rather than discounting silently

edge_cases.description: A trade parcel arrives with dozens of mixed pieces and an expectation of one price for the lot
edge_cases.trigger: a mixed-class consignment quoted as though it were a single job
edge_cases.mitigation: sort the parcel into classes and complexity bands, quote per class with the batch window stated, and flag the pieces that must be assessed individually before any figure is given

edge_cases.description: An antique piece carries an unidentifiable old plating or underplate that must be removed before any new deposit will hold
edge_cases.trigger: stripping is required on thin, worn or historically significant material
edge_cases.mitigation: treat stripping as a risk-bearing operation with its own likelihood and consequence assessment, route irreplaceable material to decline, and never price stripping as routine preparation on thin antique stock

edge_cases.description: A customer asks for a piece that will 'look solid gold and never wear', and the sale depends on agreeing
edge_cases.trigger: a request for a permanence or solid-gold representation as a condition of the order
edge_cases.mitigation: state the thickness class, the wear expectation and the verification route in writing, offer the heaviest class the piece can carry, and let the order go rather than making the representation

edge_cases.description: A rush request would break a running batch and can only be met by shortening a process step
edge_cases.trigger: an expedite date that is infeasible without truncating preparation, rinses, cycle time or inspection
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse the date with the reason stated, offer the earliest date the full process supports at the itemised surcharge, and never accept a fee in exchange for a shortened process

edge_cases.description: A piece returns within weeks showing worn gold, and the customer expects a free replate
edge_cases.trigger: a warranty claim whose cause could be workmanship or ordinary wear
edge_cases.mitigation: read the written boundary against the recorded thickness class and disclosure, refer genuine adhesion or coverage failures to defect diagnosis as workmanship, and price a re-plate as a new job where the evidence shows wear on a class the customer chose

edge_cases.description: A customer offers to supply their own gold, or asks to be charged only for metal by weight
edge_cases.trigger: a request to unbundle the metal from the service and price only the material
edge_cases.mitigation: restate that the shop sells plating work rather than bullion, decline customer-supplied material for the bath because the chemistry only accepts the commercial product it is built for, and show the labour and overhead components that a metal-only price would hide

edge_cases.description: A regular trade account requests volume pricing that would fall below the reconciled cost of the class
edge_cases.trigger: a volume discount request unsupported by any batching saving
edge_cases.mitigation: recompute the batched cost for the actual volume and grant only the saving the batch genuinely produces, hand account terms to the trade book, and decline volumes that price below the class's reconciled cost

workflow.action: Write the pricing charter and its referral lines
workflow.description: State that the shop sells work to a stated thickness class, list the honesty rules every quote inherits, and name what goes to intake, to compliance and to the trade book
workflow.gate: the four honesty rules, the three referral lines and the sells-work-not-bullion sentence are written down

workflow.action: Define the service classes by work content
workflow.description: Fix refresh, heavy replate, restore and new-work classes with their preparation assumptions, thickness duties and explicit non-inclusions
workflow.gate: each class states included work, preparation assumption, thickness duty and one thing it does not fix

workflow.action: Compute the shop rate from its cost bucket
workflow.description: Total consumables, utilities, waste fees, insurance, rent, calibration and unbillable hours, then divide by realistically billable hours
workflow.artifact: shop rate sheet with bucket and denominator
workflow.gate: the rate names its bucket, its billable-hour denominator, the period used and the recompute cadence

workflow.action: Time the bench operations into standard times
workflow.description: Stopwatch the operations of real jobs per class and complexity band, separating attended from unattended time
workflow.artifact: standard time table by class with spreads and dates
workflow.gate: every class has a dated standard time built from timed operations with attended and unattended time distinguished

workflow.action: Record the dated metal price basis
workflow.description: Take the per-unit gold cost from the latest supplier invoice or quotation including its premium, in the supplier's billing unit
workflow.gate: the basis carries its unit, source document, date and the movement tolerance that forces a refresh

workflow.action: Derive the minimum charge from the fixed steps
workflow.description: Enumerate the steps every job consumes regardless of size, price them at the shop rate, add the smallest realistic materials draw, and decide the batched small-item alternative
workflow.artifact: minimum charge derivation and small-item policy
workflow.gate: the minimum traces to enumerated fixed steps at the current rate and is stated on the menu

workflow.action: Publish the service menu from the cost build
workflow.description: Turn costed classes into named tiers with inclusions, exclusions, thickness duty, the minimum and the wear-expectation sentence, marking assessment-only tiers
workflow.artifact: published service menu with an effective date
workflow.gate: every tier traces to a cost build, names its duty and exclusions, and no tier name implies solid gold, permanence or a marking entitlement

workflow.action: Survey the incoming piece for cost drivers
workflow.description: Read substrate, existing finish, stones and organics, hollow features, joints, prior repairs, surface defects and geometry, consuming the intake condition record
workflow.gate: all seven driver categories are recorded and the substrate is tested rather than assumed where it matters

workflow.action: Fix the thickness duty for this piece
workflow.description: Argue the class from how the piece is actually worn and name the verification route that will prove it
workflow.artifact: thickness class statement with verification route
workflow.gate: the class, its duty argument and its verification are stated, with no wear-life promise anywhere

workflow.action: Build the metal line from area, thickness and the dated basis
workflow.description: Estimate the plateable area with a named method and an interior-surface decision, convert to deposit mass, apply the reconciled loss factor and the dated basis
workflow.gate: area method, interior decision, thickness class, karat basis, loss factor and basis date are all shown and the line recomputes when any changes

workflow.action: Assemble and issue the written quote
workflow.description: Combine time at the shop rate, the metal line, consumables, chosen options and the risk line into the document with its exclusions, assumptions, validity window, wear disclosure, approval condition and re-quote clause
workflow.gate: every required section is present, the risk line routes irreplaceable-consequence work to decline instead, and the validity window and basis date are stated

workflow.action: Close the job and reconcile it against the quote
workflow.description: Record actual attended time, metal drawn, consumables, options and rework on the job card and reconcile the invoice against the quote plus recorded changes
workflow.gate: quoted versus actual time and metal, options, rework and the invoice reconciliation are all present and feed the next model review

dominance_rules.rule: Safety, compliance and full process integrity dominate price, throughput and deadline
dominance_rules.rationale: a shortened preparation chain, a skipped rinse, a crowded rack or hurried chemical handling costs more than any job earns, and hazardous-chemical obligations are not commercial variables
dominance_rules.trigger: a price, a promised date or a margin can only be met by shortening a process step or relaxing a handling obligation
dominance_rules.action: refuse the shortcut, re-quote the job at the price the full process needs, and state plainly why the date or figure cannot be met

dominance_rules.rationale: a plated piece is never solid gold and never permanent, and a sale won by implying otherwise is a dispute already scheduled
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer asks for a solid-gold, permanence or lifetime representation, or a tier name drifts toward one
dominance_rules.action: state the thickness class, the wear expectation and the verification route in writing, and let the order go rather than make the claim

dominance_rules.rule: The irreplaceable-consequence decline dominates any risk premium
dominance_rules.rationale: no fee restores an heirloom, and pricing a risk implies accepting it
dominance_rules.trigger: the consequence class of potential loss on the piece is irreplaceable or uninsurable
dominance_rules.action: produce the decline verdict and hand it to intake for delivery and referral, whatever price is offered

dominance_rules.rule: The thickness owed to the agreed duty dominates the price ceiling
dominance_rules.rationale: silently thinning a deposit sells a piece that will fail early while the customer believes they bought the class they were quoted
dominance_rules.trigger: the mechanism-built price exceeds what the customer will pay for the agreed class
dominance_rules.action: re-scope to a lower class with its wear expectation stated in writing, or decline; never reduce the deposit inside the quoted class

dominance_rules.rule: The dated basis and the written validity window dominate a remembered price
dominance_rules.rationale: metal moves and memory does not, so an undated figure is a loss waiting to be honoured
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer or an operator quotes a figure from a previous job or an expired document
dominance_rules.action: recompute the metal line at the current dated basis and re-issue with a fresh window before anything is committed

dominance_rules.rule: The written quote dominates verbal recollection when they disagree
dominance_rules.rationale: the document is the only version both parties read the same way weeks later
dominance_rules.trigger: a dispute arises about what was included, excluded or promised
dominance_rules.action: settle from the issued quote and its recorded changes, and if the document was silent, treat that as a defect to fix in the standard quote rather than a debate to win

dominance_rules.rule: The reconciled cost build dominates a competitor's advertised price
dominance_rules.rationale: matching a number whose cost basis you cannot see is how a shop sells its own gold and hours at a loss
dominance_rules.trigger: pressure to match a lower figure quoted elsewhere
dominance_rules.action: explain what the price contains, offer a lower class honestly if one fits the duty, and decline to match below the reconciled cost

dominance_rules.rule: Stop-and-re-quote dominates continuing into discovered work
dominance_rules.rationale: work performed without authorisation is unbillable at best and irreversible at worst
dominance_rules.trigger: the job proves materially different from the surveyed and quoted scope
dominance_rules.action: halt at the discovery, price the delta from the same mechanism, and wait for a recorded decision before proceeding past any irreversible step

dominance_rules.rule: Logged actuals dominate the standing assumption when the two disagree
dominance_rules.rationale: the model exists to be corrected by the shop's own evidence, not to be defended against it
dominance_rules.trigger: job cards contradict a standard time, a loss factor or a tier's assumed margin
dominance_rules.action: revise the input at the next review with a dated change note rather than dismissing the cards as unusual jobs

dominance_rules.rule: The bench's own substrate test dominates the customer's description of the piece
dominance_rules.rationale: an honest customer can still be wrong about what their jewellery is made of, and the process consequences land on the shop
dominance_rules.trigger: the quoted price depends on the substrate and only the customer's word identifies it
dominance_rules.action: test what can be tested, record the assumption explicitly in the quote where it cannot, and treat a wrong substrate as a scope change rather than an absorbed cost

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the service class before writing any number
anti_rework_rules.prevents: quoting a refresh and then performing a restore, which is unrecoverable once the customer has accepted the figure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Survey the piece's cost drivers before estimating area or time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an area and time estimate built on a substrate, finish or construction that turns out to be something else entirely

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the thickness duty before computing metal
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding the whole metal line because the class was decided after the price was already discussed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Date the metal basis at the moment of quoting
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an undated figure that cannot be defended or refreshed when gold moves before approval

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the validity window and movement clause into the quote itself
anti_rework_rules.prevents: honouring stale quotes at a loss or re-pricing in a way the customer experiences as bad faith

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put exclusions and the wear disclosure in the quote before any deposit is taken
anti_rework_rules.prevents: arguments at collection about dents, stone tightening, colour matching and durability that were never in scope

anti_rework_rules.rule: Derive the minimum charge before publishing any menu
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a printed price list whose small-job tiers cannot cover one setup and must be withdrawn

anti_rework_rules.rule: Time real jobs before publishing standard times or tier prices
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a whole season of work sold against imagined times that reconciliation then exposes as loss-making

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the decline criteria before standing at the counter with the piece in your hand
anti_rework_rules.prevents: accepting an irreplaceable or chronically unprofitable job under social pressure and regretting it for years

anti_rework_rules.rule: Open a job card at the first job, not after the model starts feeling wrong
anti_rework_rules.prevents: having no evidence base when the price model finally needs correcting, forcing another season of guessing

iteration_protocol.trigger: the metal basis moves beyond the tolerance the validity windows assume
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the dated basis, recompute the metal line on open quotes under the movement clause, and review whether published tiers and window lengths still hold

iteration_protocol.trigger: job cards show a class is systematically under-quoted on time or metal
iteration_protocol.action: retime the class, re-derive its standard time and loss factor, and re-price the tier with a dated change note

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new service route or capability is added, such as selective touch-up work or a new finishing option
iteration_protocol.action: define its class and thickness duty, time it, cost it and only then add it to the menu with its own exclusions

iteration_protocol.trigger: warranty returns or damage events exceed the reserve or the assumed likelihood
iteration_protocol.action: recalibrate the risk likelihood factors and the class reserve, and re-examine whether the thickness duty for that class was ever right

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same scope discovery keeps recurring on a piece type
iteration_protocol.action: add the driver to the survey checklist and to the class's stated assumptions so it is priced up front instead of discovered mid-job

iteration_protocol.trigger: utilities, consumables, waste-handling fees or insurance step up materially
iteration_protocol.action: recompute the shop rate and the minimum charge, then republish affected tiers with a new effective date

iteration_protocol.trigger: a trade customer or retailer asks for volume pricing
iteration_protocol.action: recompute the batched cost at the real volume, concede only the saving batching genuinely produces, and hand the account terms themselves to the trade book

iteration_protocol.trigger: rush requests become frequent enough to reshape the week
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the expedite components, tighten which dates may be promised, and check that batch fill rates have not collapsed

priority_rationale: The charter, the class taxonomy and the shop's own cost inputs (rate, standard times, dated metal basis) come first because nothing downstream can be honest without them; the per-piece survey, area, thickness duty and the metal mechanism then build the job-specific cost stack; minimum, batching and rush adjust it for the fixed and displaced costs that per-piece thinking hides; menu, quote, validity window, change order and decline are the customer-facing outputs that must never be issued before the build behind them exists; and reconciliation and the scheduled review sit last because they are the feedback that keeps every earlier number true.
